$comment: Budgets for scripts/check-size.mjs, in KiB of gzip-compressed bytes (level 9). shellJs covers every .js file outside vendor/ (the app and its lazily loaded studios, panels and engines, plus the service worker). startupJs is what must load before the app is usable (index.html modules and their static imports). total covers everything the browser downloads (dist/) except fonts, license texts and the on-demand libraries (PDF import, KaTeX), which are not precached. 0.7.0: shellJs +50 for collaboration (app/src/collab + ui/collab, about 40 KiB, all lazy; start-up only gains the small command stubs). Next: shellJs +20 for Edit together (tree and text CRDTs, live bindings), LAN relay helpers and the QR encoder (all lazy; start-up gains only the share commands and one context-menu provider). VS Code extensions: shellJs +35 and total +30 (code, styles and catalog texts) (app/src/vscode + the manager tab, about 25 KiB, all lazy; loaded only when a VS Code extension is installed or the tab is opened). Open folders from the OS: totalGzipKiB +10 (folder-scan.js, the folder reader and German strings, about 4 KiB; the rest is headroom for the next change).
